description: C20 帕勒姆进攻 — 后早出，被轻子反复威胁，每追一次失去一步先手

intro.popup_en: Rapid Development, Lesson 3: The queen is the most valuable major piece, worth about nine points. See the cost of bringing it out too early: White plays Qh5 on move two.
intro.popup:
快速出子第3课
后是9分的最大重子
今天看看，过早出动的代价！
白方将走Qh5——仅第2步就出后！

outro.popup_en: The early queen loses time: ...g6, a one-point pawn, drives the queen from h5, and ...Nd4, a three-point knight, drives it again from f3. The queen is powerful but becomes a burden when exposed. Develop minor pieces first and let the queen support them from behind.
outro.popup:
总结：后早出的代价
Qh5被g6（1分兵）追→浪费1步先手
Qf3被Nd4（3分马）追→浪费1步先手
后是最强子，却成了最大的包袱
正确做法：先出轻子，后在后方保护

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center on White's first move.
moves.popup:
e4占领中心
开局第一步

moves.popup_en: ...e5 also occupies the center.
moves.popup:
e5对称
黑方也占中心

moves.popup_en: Qh5?! White brings out the queen on move two. It attacks e5 and threatens Qxe5+ or Qxf7 mate, but the queen is exposed and can be chased by minor pieces.
moves.popup:
⚠️ Qh5！后第1次出动
开局仅第2步，后就冲出来了！
表面上攻击e5，威胁Qxe5+甚至Qxf7#
但后暴露在外边——等着被轻子赶！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's first minor piece, protects e5, and prepares to meet the queen's threats.
moves.popup:
Nc6出动
黑方第1个轻子
保护e5兵，同时做好迎接后续的准备

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops White's bishop.
moves.popup:
Bc4发展
白方象出动

moves.popup_en: ...g6! A one-point pawn attacks the nine-point queen. White must move the queen, losing a tempo while Black gains development time.
moves.popup:
g6！仅一个兵，就把9分的后赶走！
关键时刻：
黑方用1分的兵，威胁9分的后
后必须逃——白方白白浪费了一步先手！

moves.popup_en: Qf3 is the queen's second move. Instead, White could have developed Nf3. The queen has moved twice while White has developed no minor pieces, losing a tempo.
moves.popup:
Qf3 — 后第2次移动！
后Qh5→Qf3，被一个兵追着跑
⚠️ 这一步本可以走Nf3发展马
白方浪费了1步先手：后走了2步，出了0个轻子

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6! Black develops a second minor piece while attacking e4. White has spent two moves on the queen; Black has developed two pieces.
moves.popup:
Nf6！黑方第2个轻子出动
发展出子，同时攻击e4
对比白方：后用了2步，黑方出了2个轻子

moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes the center and prepares to develop the bishops and knights.
moves.popup:
d3稳固中心
为象和马的发展做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7! Black develops a third minor piece and controls the long diagonal. Black brings out a new piece with each move.
moves.popup:
Bg7！黑方第3个轻子出动
象到g7，控制长对角线
黑方每步都在出新子

moves.popup_en: Ne2 finally develops White's first knight. Because the queen occupies f3, the knight cannot use its natural Nf3 square; the early queen move has obstructed development.
moves.popup:
Ne2出动
白方终于出第1个马
注意：因为后占着f3，马只能走Ne2而不是Nf3
后的早出连马的发展位置都被占了！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes the center and opens a diagonal for Black's bishop.
moves.popup:
d6稳固
黑方第4步：巩固中心
为象的出动打开通道

moves.popup_en: Nbc3 develops White's second knight.
moves.popup:
Nbc3出动
白方第2个马出动

moves.popup_en: ...Be6! Black develops the fourth minor piece and attacks White's bishop on c4. Black is ready to castle.
moves.popup:
Be6！黑方第4个轻子出动
还攻击白方Bc4
黑方4个轻子全部出动，随时可以易位！

moves.popup_en: Bg5 develops White's bishop and pins Nf6.
moves.popup:
Bg5出动
白方象出动，牵制Nf6

moves.popup_en: ...Nd4! The knight attacks White's queen again. First ...g6 drove it from h5 to f3; now ...Nd4 forces another retreat from f3. Do not trade a nine-point queen for a three-point knight.
moves.popup:
Nd4！⚠️ 黑马跳入d4——再次威胁白后！
第1次：兵g6追后（Qh5退到Qf3）
第2次：马Nd4追后（Qf3再退）
马只有3分，但后9分不可以与之交换！

moves.popup_en: Qe3 is the queen's third move: Qh5-f3-e3. Those three tempi could have developed three minor pieces. Worse, ...Nxe2 is also threatened, leaving White under pressure.
moves.popup:
Qe3 — 后第3次移动！
后Qh5→Qf3→Qe3，已经走了3步！
3步本可以发展3个轻子
⚠️ 更糟糕的是：Nd4还有Nxe2的后续手！
白方非常被动

moves.popup_en: ...Nxe2! Black's knight captures White's knight on e2 and initiates an exchange.
moves.popup: Nxe2！黑马主动吃掉Ne2交换！

moves.popup_en: Nxe2 recaptures and completes the exchange.
moves.popup: 白方吃掉黑马， 交换

moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles with all four minor pieces developed and the king safe. White has spent three tempi moving the queen and is behind in development.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方从容易位
4个轻子全出，王安全，出子完整
对比白方：后走了3步，局面落后

moves.popup_en: O-O finally secures White's king, but the cost of the early queen sortie has already been paid.
moves.popup:
O-O白方也易位
但代价已经付出了

moves.popup_en: ...c6 reinforces Black's position.
moves.popup:
c6巩固
黑方稳固

moves.popup_en: d4 advances in the center. Review the queen's route: Qh5-f3-e3 used three tempi. In the same time, Black developed Nf6, Bg7, and Be6. The queen is strongest when it supports developed pieces from the rear, not when it becomes an early target.
moves.popup:
d4推进中心
回顾后的轨迹：Qh5→Qf3→Qe3
后走了3步 = 浪费3步先手
黑方同样3步：出了Nf6、Bg7、Be6三个轻子
后（9分）早早出动，却成了全局的累赘
后应该待在后方保护轻子，等时机成熟再出击！
